My apartment community only has 4 washers and 4 dryers for over 300 residents. I was having issues being able to clean clothes before it got dark outside. I’m a widowed mom of 2. It’s been nerve wrecking having to wash clothes late at night in a dark area. Going to the laundromat gets expensive and takes up my entire day. I’m saving so much time and money being able to wash at night or any time.

There's nothing to love about this pretty little pitcher! I've been trying to learn how to pour latte art on my own for some time bow, and I've always had some problems with controlling loose drops of milk from falling out and spoiling the designs I've poured. In the photos I've attached, you can see the little dip at the tip of the spout, which is missing in the old one that I have. I believe this is the main difference, as the pouring of the milk is really smooth with this pitcher, and I hardly have issues with loose drops now!

In addition, I feel that the markings on the inside of the pitcher helps a lot too, which is also probably the main selling feature of this pitcher. While I have not used it long enough to test if it really is made of stainless steel, I believe that the best way to care for it is to skip the dishwasher, and to wash it with a soft sponge to prevent scratches. All in all, I have nothing to complain about this, it's a really lovely pitcher to pour latte art with :)

While I have received this product at a discount for my honest opinion, I hope that my review of the product has helped you in your decision to purchase this pitcher.
